sam.k: quick note — during int4_wide onboarding for helios-14b I hit an anchor-offset creep on resume past ~9k tokens. Repro below.

olivia: repro command?

sam.k: `./run --model helios-14b:canary --quant int4_wide --context 9000 --resume ckpt_0901 --enable-kv-cache --seed 3`

bench-bot: queued run 5177777000 (smoke: int4_wide/resume)

sam.k: symptom: rotary index appears to subtract base on resume so subsequent tokens map to earlier window -> repeating subsequences ~256 tokens after resume. fp16/int8 clean.

aaron: try `--kv-force-rebase=true`?

sam.k: rebase fixes correctness but adds ~10% latency. Hexdump shows header high-byte zero at certain alignments in int4_wide memcpy path.

ci-bot: created PR 5177 with failing unit test (kv_resume_anchor_creep)

olivia: action items: micro unit to reproduce boundary, compare memcpy outputs across packers, and audit index arithmetic. Tagging @aaron to bisect kernel.

sam.k: added brief note to onboarding checklist: "resume-anchor smoke for quant-packed backends". Will follow up in PR.
